add_decision_rules.name: Version every configuration item
add_decision_rules.condition: a configuration item (file, setting, or parameter set) is created or changed
add_decision_rules.outcome: store it under version control so every change has an author, timestamp, and diff

add_decision_rules.name: Establish a baseline before changing
add_decision_rules.condition: a change to configuration is about to be made
add_decision_rules.outcome: record the current approved configuration as a baseline first so the change can be compared with it and undone

add_decision_rules.name: Route changes through change control
add_decision_rules.outcome: record what changes, why, and who approved it before applying it

add_decision_rules.name: Keep configuration traceable
add_decision_rules.condition: a configuration state is deployed or reported
add_decision_rules.outcome: link that state to the exact version and the change that produced it

add_heuristics.condition: the same configuration step is repeated by hand more than once
add_heuristics.action: automate that step so it is applied identically every time

add_heuristics.condition: deployed configuration differs from the recorded baseline
add_heuristics.action: treat the difference as drift and either reconcile it to the baseline or record it as a controlled change

add_decision_rules.name: Use resource-oriented endpoints
add_decision_rules.condition: an API endpoint is being designed
add_decision_rules.outcome: model it around a resource noun and use the HTTP method to express the action

add_decision_rules.name: Preserve backward compatibility
add_decision_rules.condition: an existing API contract needs to change
add_decision_rules.outcome: version the change or make it additive so existing clients keep working

add_decision_rules.name: Return consistent errors
add_decision_rules.outcome: return a status code that matches the failure class and an error body with the same shape across all endpoints

add_decision_rules.name: Document every endpoint
add_decision_rules.condition: an endpoint is added or changed
add_decision_rules.outcome: document its path, method, inputs, outputs, and error cases in the same change

add_heuristics.condition: a change would rename or remove a field or endpoint
add_heuristics.action: prefer adding a new field or version and deprecating the old one instead

add_heuristics.condition: two endpoints behave differently for the same kind of input
add_heuristics.action: align them to one convention rather than documenting the difference

add_decision_rules.name: Grant least privilege
add_decision_rules.condition: access is being granted to a subject (user, service, or role)
add_decision_rules.outcome: grant only the permissions the subject's task requires and nothing broader

add_decision_rules.name: Limit access to need-to-know
add_decision_rules.outcome: allow access only to subjects with a stated need for that data

add_decision_rules.name: Separate duties
add_decision_rules.condition: one action chain would let a single subject both initiate and approve a sensitive operation
add_decision_rules.outcome: split the steps between different subjects

add_decision_rules.name: Deny by default
add_decision_rules.condition: no rule explicitly allows the requested access
add_decision_rules.outcome: deny the request

add_heuristics.condition: a permission was granted for a temporary task
add_heuristics.action: review it when the task ends and remove it if no longer required

add_heuristics.condition: a role keeps accumulating permissions
add_heuristics.action: split it into narrower roles

add_decision_rules.name: Order startup by dependency
add_decision_rules.condition: a boot or startup sequence is defined
add_decision_rules.outcome: start each stage only after the stages it depends on have completed and declare those dependencies explicitly

add_decision_rules.name: Make each stage's failure explicit
add_decision_rules.outcome: stop or fall back to a defined recovery path instead of continuing in an unknown state

add_decision_rules.name: Keep handoffs explicit
add_decision_rules.condition: control passes between firmware, loader, or software stages
add_decision_rules.outcome: define what state and parameters are handed over and verify them on receipt

add_decision_rules.name: Log boot progress
add_decision_rules.condition: a boot stage starts or ends
add_decision_rules.outcome: record the stage and its outcome so a failed boot can be diagnosed

add_heuristics.condition: two boot runs with the same inputs behave differently
add_heuristics.action: look for hidden dependencies or timing assumptions and make them explicit

add_heuristics.condition: a stage can be skipped without any later stage noticing
add_heuristics.action: add a check that proves it ran

add_decision_rules.name: Version every configuration item
add_decision_rules.condition: a configuration item is created or changed
add_decision_rules.outcome: keep it under version control with a recorded history

add_decision_rules.name: Control changes
add_decision_rules.outcome: record and approve the change before it is applied

add_decision_rules.name: Track configuration assets
add_decision_rules.condition: a system component is added, moved, or retired
add_decision_rules.outcome: update the register of configuration items to match

add_decision_rules.name: Standardize configuration
add_decision_rules.condition: a new system of an existing type is configured
add_decision_rules.outcome: start from the established standard configuration and record any deviation

add_decision_rules.name: Keep an audit trail
add_decision_rules.outcome: retain who changed it, when, and what the previous value was

add_heuristics.condition: configuration is found that is not in the register
add_heuristics.action: investigate its origin and either register it or remove it

add_heuristics.condition: the same deviation is recorded repeatedly
add_heuristics.action: consider updating the standard to include it

add_decision_rules.name: Define consistency rules first
add_decision_rules.condition: a dataset is to be checked for consistency
add_decision_rules.outcome: write down the explicit rules or constraints being checked before running the check

add_decision_rules.name: Validate at data entry points
add_decision_rules.condition: data enters, is transformed, or is read from a store
add_decision_rules.outcome: run the defined checks at that point

add_decision_rules.name: Report violations with context
add_decision_rules.outcome: report which rule failed, on which record, with the conflicting values

add_decision_rules.name: Keep an audit trail
add_decision_rules.condition: a violation is resolved or reconciled
add_decision_rules.outcome: record what was changed and why

add_heuristics.condition: the same rule keeps failing on new data
add_heuristics.action: look for a defect upstream instead of repairing records one by one

add_heuristics.condition: two sources disagree and neither is designated authoritative
add_heuristics.action: flag it for resolution rather than choosing silently

add_decision_rules.name: Protect shared data with locking or isolation
add_decision_rules.condition: two or more operations may access the same data at the same time
add_decision_rules.outcome: use a locking or isolation mechanism so they do not interfere

add_decision_rules.name: Keep transactions atomic
add_decision_rules.condition: a change spans several data operations
add_decision_rules.outcome: make them succeed or fail together

add_decision_rules.name: Choose the isolation level deliberately
add_decision_rules.outcome: state the isolation level and which anomalies it permits

add_decision_rules.name: Prevent deadlock
add_decision_rules.outcome: acquire them in a consistent order or use timeouts

add_heuristics.condition: contention on a lock is high
add_heuristics.action: shorten the critical section or narrow the lock scope before weakening isolation

add_heuristics.condition: a result depends on interleaving of operations
add_heuristics.action: treat it as a serializability problem and verify with concurrent tests

add_decision_rules.name: Diagnose before restoring
add_decision_rules.condition: a component is to be restored
add_decision_rules.outcome: identify the root cause of its failure before applying any intervention

add_decision_rules.name: Restore components independently
add_decision_rules.outcome: isolate and restore them one at a time so faults are not conflated

add_decision_rules.name: Preserve baseline state
add_decision_rules.outcome: return it to its baseline condition without unnecessary modifications

add_decision_rules.name: Make steps reversible
add_decision_rules.outcome: choose or prepare it so it can be undone if it causes damage

add_heuristics.condition: the cause of failure is unclear
add_heuristics.action: do not proceed to restoration until the cause is established or the uncertainty is recorded

add_heuristics.condition: a restoration step cannot be undone
add_heuristics.action: record the state beforehand so it can at least be reproduced

add_decision_rules.name: Pin dependency versions
add_decision_rules.condition: a dependency is added or updated
add_decision_rules.outcome: specify an explicit version rather than an open-ended range

add_decision_rules.name: Scan dependencies for known vulnerabilities
add_decision_rules.condition: dependencies are added, updated, or periodically reviewed
add_decision_rules.outcome: run a security scan and record findings before accepting the change

add_decision_rules.name: Update deliberately
add_decision_rules.outcome: change it in a separate, reviewable step and verify the project still builds and passes its checks

add_heuristics.condition: a dependency has had no maintenance for a long time
add_heuristics.action: consider whether to replace it

add_heuristics.condition: the same dependency appears at several versions
add_heuristics.action: align them to one version where possible

add_decision_rules.name: Check accuracy
add_decision_rules.condition: data is accepted into a system
add_decision_rules.outcome: verify values against the source or a known reference where one exists

add_decision_rules.name: Check validity
add_decision_rules.condition: a field has a defined type, range, or format
add_decision_rules.outcome: reject or flag values that do not conform

add_decision_rules.name: Check consistency
add_decision_rules.outcome: verify they do not contradict each other

add_decision_rules.name: Report rejected data
add_decision_rules.outcome: report which value failed which check instead of dropping it silently

add_heuristics.condition: validation rules are undocumented
add_heuristics.action: write them down before relying on the results

add_heuristics.condition: many records fail the same check
add_heuristics.action: examine the data source before loosening the check

add_decision_rules.name: Define matching criteria explicitly
add_decision_rules.condition: records are to be compared for duplication
add_decision_rules.outcome: state the fields and comparison method used before matching

add_decision_rules.name: Apply the same criteria consistently
add_decision_rules.outcome: use the same criteria for every record

add_decision_rules.name: Preserve unique records
add_decision_rules.condition: two records are only partially similar
add_decision_rules.outcome: keep both unless the criteria confirm they are the same entity

add_decision_rules.name: Log deduplication actions
add_decision_rules.condition: a duplicate is merged or removed
add_decision_rules.outcome: record which records were merged or removed and why

add_heuristics.condition: uncertain matches are found
add_heuristics.action: hold them for review instead of merging automatically

add_heuristics.condition: deduplication removes a large share of the data
add_heuristics.action: check the criteria for false matches before accepting the result

add_decision_rules.name: Prevent errors at their source
add_decision_rules.condition: a function or process receives input or depends on a resource
add_decision_rules.outcome: check preconditions before acting

add_decision_rules.name: Report errors meaningfully
add_decision_rules.outcome: report what failed, where, and with what input, in a consistent format

add_decision_rules.name: Do not swallow errors
add_decision_rules.outcome: handle it, propagate it, or log it - never discard it silently

add_heuristics.condition: an error message would not help a reader fix the problem
add_heuristics.action: add the context they would need

add_heuristics.condition: the same error is handled in many places
add_heuristics.action: centralize its handling

add_decision_rules.name: Define parent-child relationships
add_decision_rules.outcome: give every node exactly one defined parent (except the root) and a stated relationship to it

add_decision_rules.name: Choose structuring direction deliberately
add_decision_rules.condition: a hierarchy is built from a set of items
add_decision_rules.outcome: decide whether to structure top-down or bottom-up and record which

add_decision_rules.name: Keep levels consistent
add_decision_rules.condition: nodes are added to a level
add_decision_rules.outcome: make them the same kind of thing as their siblings

add_decision_rules.name: Keep it navigable
add_decision_rules.outcome: ensure every node can be reached from the root by following the structure

add_heuristics.condition: a node has too many children to scan
add_heuristics.action: introduce an intermediate grouping level

add_heuristics.condition: a node has only one child
add_heuristics.action: check whether the level is needed

add_decision_rules.name: Parse defensively
add_decision_rules.outcome: treat it as untrusted and reject malformed requests or responses instead of guessing

add_decision_rules.name: Determine the payload boundary correctly
add_decision_rules.condition: an HTTP message has a body
add_decision_rules.outcome: use the declared length or chunked framing to find where it ends, and handle compressed bodies as declared

add_decision_rules.name: Interpret methods and status codes by their meaning
add_decision_rules.condition: a request or response is handled
add_decision_rules.outcome: act on the method and status code according to their standard semantics

add_decision_rules.name: Follow the HTTP/1.1 message specification
add_decision_rules.outcome: follow the relevant RFC (7230-7235) rather than local convention

add_heuristics.condition: a header or length value is conflicting or duplicated
add_heuristics.action: reject the message rather than choosing one

add_heuristics.condition: a parser accepts input the specification forbids
add_heuristics.action: tighten it

add_decision_rules.name: Validate at the trust boundary
add_decision_rules.condition: input crosses from an untrusted source into the system
add_decision_rules.outcome: validate it there before any use

add_decision_rules.name: Fail fast
add_decision_rules.outcome: reject it immediately with an error instead of continuing

add_decision_rules.name: Allowlist, not blocklist
add_decision_rules.outcome: define what is allowed and reject everything else

add_decision_rules.name: Apply context-specific rules
add_decision_rules.condition: input is used in a particular context (SQL, HTML, path, command)
add_decision_rules.outcome: validate and encode it for that context

add_decision_rules.name: Encode output
add_decision_rules.condition: stored input is later displayed or passed on
add_decision_rules.outcome: encode it for the destination

add_heuristics.condition: validation is done only in the client
add_heuristics.action: repeat it on the receiving side

add_heuristics.condition: a blocklist is growing
add_heuristics.action: replace it with an allowlist

add_decision_rules.name: State scale
add_decision_rules.outcome: state its scale so distances can be interpreted

add_decision_rules.name: State projection
add_decision_rules.outcome: record the coordinate projection used and keep it consistent across layers

add_decision_rules.name: Provide a legend
add_decision_rules.outcome: include a legend that explains each one

add_decision_rules.name: Keep the map accurate
add_decision_rules.outcome: place them according to their source data and cite the source

add_heuristics.condition: a map is crowded
add_heuristics.action: simplify or split it by theme rather than shrinking symbols

add_heuristics.condition: layers come from different sources
add_heuristics.action: confirm they share a projection before overlaying

add_decision_rules.name: Treat reliability as a system property
add_decision_rules.outcome: assess interactions between components, not only components alone

add_decision_rules.name: Plan for variability
add_decision_rules.condition: a system or process is designed
add_decision_rules.outcome: state what variation and disturbances are expected and how the system adjusts to them

add_decision_rules.name: Learn from failures and near-misses
add_decision_rules.outcome: record it and analyze contributing factors across the system

add_decision_rules.name: Preserve adaptive capacity
add_decision_rules.outcome: check that it does not remove the ability of people or systems to adapt to unexpected conditions

add_heuristics.condition: an incident is blamed on a single component
add_heuristics.action: also look for the interactions that allowed it

add_heuristics.condition: a near-miss is dismissed as harmless
add_heuristics.action: review it as an early warning

add_decision_rules.name: Test with a defined purpose
add_decision_rules.outcome: state what defect or behavior it is meant to expose

add_decision_rules.name: Do not claim absence of defects
add_decision_rules.outcome: report only that no defects were found by these tests, not that none exist

add_decision_rules.name: Test early
add_decision_rules.condition: a feature or change is being developed
add_decision_rules.outcome: write or run tests as soon as the behavior exists

add_decision_rules.name: Match testing to context
add_decision_rules.outcome: choose it for the kind of system and risk involved

add_decision_rules.name: Refresh tests
add_decision_rules.condition: a test suite has not changed while the code has
add_decision_rules.outcome: review and add cases so it does not miss new defects

add_heuristics.condition: defects concentrate in one module
add_heuristics.action: increase testing there

add_heuristics.condition: exhaustive testing is not possible
add_heuristics.action: prioritize by risk

add_decision_rules.name: Keep state consistent
add_decision_rules.condition: state changes in one component that others depend on
add_decision_rules.outcome: propagate it so dependent components do not hold contradictory state

add_decision_rules.name: Use deterministic transitions
add_decision_rules.outcome: define the same input and state as always producing the same next state

add_decision_rules.name: Propagate by event
add_decision_rules.outcome: emit an update to the dependents instead of requiring them to poll

add_decision_rules.name: Order updates by dependency
add_decision_rules.condition: several dependent states must be updated
add_decision_rules.outcome: update them in topological order so each is computed after its inputs

add_heuristics.condition: a cycle appears in the dependencies
add_heuristics.action: resolve it explicitly instead of looping

add_heuristics.condition: an update is seen twice
add_heuristics.action: make applying it idempotent

add_decision_rules.name: Compare against the source of truth
add_decision_rules.outcome: compare stored records with the designated source of truth

add_decision_rules.name: Check completeness
add_decision_rules.outcome: identify records missing from either side

add_decision_rules.name: Check consistency across stores
add_decision_rules.condition: data lives in more than one store
add_decision_rules.outcome: verify the stores agree and list the differences

add_decision_rules.name: Document each step
add_decision_rules.outcome: record the discrepancy, the decision, and the change made

add_heuristics.condition: the source of truth is disputed
add_heuristics.action: settle which is authoritative before correcting data

add_heuristics.condition: the same discrepancy recurs
add_heuristics.action: find the writer that causes it

add_decision_rules.name: Divide the system into modules
add_decision_rules.outcome: define modules with clear responsibilities and interfaces

add_decision_rules.name: Reduce coupling
add_decision_rules.outcome: depend only on its interface, not its internals

add_decision_rules.name: State scalability expectations
add_decision_rules.outcome: state the load or growth it is meant to handle and where it would first strain

add_heuristics.condition: a module has several unrelated responsibilities
add_heuristics.action: split it

add_heuristics.condition: a change requires edits in many modules
add_heuristics.action: review the boundaries

add_decision_rules.name: Verify accuracy
add_decision_rules.condition: a claim, value, or output is to be verified
add_decision_rules.outcome: compare it with an authoritative source or independent check

add_decision_rules.name: Keep verification traceable
add_decision_rules.outcome: record what was checked, against what, and the result

add_decision_rules.name: Report unverified items
add_decision_rules.outcome: mark it unverified instead of treating it as correct

add_heuristics.condition: only one source supports a claim
add_heuristics.action: seek a second independent one

add_heuristics.condition: a check is not repeatable
add_heuristics.action: document how to repeat it

add_decision_rules.name: Map the workflow first
add_decision_rules.condition: a repetitive task is to be automated
add_decision_rules.outcome: map its steps, inputs, and outputs before automating

add_decision_rules.name: Build in modular steps
add_decision_rules.outcome: implement each step as a separate unit that can be tested and reused

add_decision_rules.name: Execute consistently
add_decision_rules.outcome: run it the same way each time and record the result

add_heuristics.condition: a step needs a human judgment
add_heuristics.action: keep it manual and automate around it

add_heuristics.condition: a task is rare or changes often
add_heuristics.action: check that automating it is worthwhile

add_decision_rules.name: Automate container deployment
add_decision_rules.outcome: use orchestration or scripts rather than manual commands

add_decision_rules.name: Isolate containers
add_decision_rules.outcome: limit its privileges, resources, and network access to what it needs

add_decision_rules.name: Plan for scale and failure
add_decision_rules.outcome: define how it scales and how it recovers when a container stops

add_heuristics.condition: a container runs as a privileged user
add_heuristics.action: reduce its privileges

add_heuristics.condition: a container has no resource limits
add_heuristics.action: set them

add_decision_rules.name: State capabilities precisely
add_decision_rules.outcome: use specific, unambiguous language stating what it does and under what conditions

add_decision_rules.name: Use standard terms
add_decision_rules.outcome: use the same terminology, format, and classification for all of them

add_decision_rules.name: Keep declarations traceable
add_decision_rules.outcome: record its source and a version, and update it when requirements change

add_heuristics.condition: a declaration uses a vague word
add_heuristics.action: replace it with a measurable statement

add_heuristics.condition: a declared capability is no longer provided
add_heuristics.action: remove or update the declaration

add_decision_rules.name: Treat infrastructure as immutable
add_decision_rules.condition: a running container needs a change
add_decision_rules.outcome: build and deploy a new image instead of changing the running container

add_decision_rules.name: Configure declaratively
add_decision_rules.outcome: describe the desired state in a configuration file kept in version control

add_decision_rules.name: Govern resources and isolation
add_decision_rules.outcome: set resource limits and isolation boundaries

add_decision_rules.name: Make it observable
add_decision_rules.outcome: expose logs and health information so failures can be seen

add_heuristics.condition: a container is changed by hand
add_heuristics.action: rebuild from the declared configuration

add_heuristics.condition: a container cannot be restarted safely
add_heuristics.action: fix that before scaling it

add_decision_rules.name: Keep registry entries consistent
add_decision_rules.condition: an entry is added to a registry
add_decision_rules.outcome: use the same schema and naming as existing entries

add_decision_rules.name: Control access
add_decision_rules.condition: a registry is read or written
add_decision_rules.outcome: restrict writes to authorized parties and record who made each change

add_decision_rules.name: Keep the registry able to grow
add_decision_rules.outcome: check that lookup remains fast and unambiguous

add_heuristics.condition: two entries describe the same thing
add_heuristics.action: merge or cross-reference them

add_heuristics.condition: an entry is stale
add_heuristics.action: mark or remove it

add_decision_rules.name: Align capabilities with strategy
add_decision_rules.condition: a capability is considered for development or investment
add_decision_rules.outcome: tie it to a stated strategic objective

add_decision_rules.name: Identify core competencies
add_decision_rules.outcome: distinguish the ones that differentiate the organization from the supporting ones

add_decision_rules.name: Review capabilities regularly
add_decision_rules.condition: a period passes or conditions change
add_decision_rules.outcome: reassess which capabilities remain needed

add_decision_rules.name: Allocate resources by value
add_decision_rules.outcome: favor capabilities that deliver the most value to the stated objective

add_heuristics.condition: a capability supports no objective
add_heuristics.action: question whether it should be maintained

add_heuristics.condition: a capability is a gap
add_heuristics.action: identify what is needed to build or acquire it

add_decision_rules.name: Prepare a rollback before deploying
add_decision_rules.condition: a deployment is about to start
add_decision_rules.outcome: have a tested rollback path ready before it begins

add_decision_rules.name: Define rollback triggers
add_decision_rules.outcome: define in advance the conditions that trigger rollback

add_decision_rules.name: Preserve data consistency
add_decision_rules.outcome: ensure data written during the deployment is handled so it stays consistent

add_decision_rules.name: Limit exposure
add_decision_rules.outcome: release it to a small portion first so failures affect little

add_heuristics.condition: rollback has never been tested
add_heuristics.action: test it before relying on it

add_heuristics.condition: a change alters data format
add_heuristics.action: plan how to restore data compatible with the old version

add_decision_rules.name: Handle errors explicitly
add_decision_rules.outcome: check for and handle the failure at that point

add_decision_rules.name: Design recovery
add_decision_rules.outcome: define what it does on failure and how it returns to normal

add_decision_rules.name: Use resilience patterns where they fit
add_decision_rules.condition: a call depends on another service
add_decision_rules.outcome: apply timeouts and bounded retries so one failure does not spread

add_heuristics.condition: a retry could repeat a side effect
add_heuristics.action: make the operation idempotent first

add_heuristics.condition: failure paths are never exercised
add_heuristics.action: test them deliberately

add_decision_rules.name: Validate at the system boundary
add_decision_rules.outcome: validate it at the boundary before use

add_decision_rules.name: Use allowlists
add_decision_rules.outcome: accept only known-good values and reject everything else

add_decision_rules.name: Fail securely
add_decision_rules.outcome: reject it instead of processing it

add_decision_rules.name: Layer validation
add_decision_rules.outcome: validate at more than one layer

add_decision_rules.name: Preserve integrity
add_decision_rules.outcome: make sure it is stored as received after validation, without silent alteration

add_heuristics.condition: a check exists in only one layer
add_heuristics.action: consider whether a second layer is needed

add_heuristics.condition: data is altered during validation
add_heuristics.action: record the alteration

add_decision_rules.name: Declare capabilities in a standard form
add_decision_rules.outcome: declare it using the standard declaration format

add_decision_rules.name: Grant least privilege
add_decision_rules.condition: an MCP capability is given access
add_decision_rules.outcome: give it only the access it needs

add_decision_rules.name: Manage the lifecycle
add_decision_rules.condition: an MCP capability is added, changed, or retired
add_decision_rules.outcome: update the registry and remove access when it retires

add_decision_rules.name: Audit use
add_decision_rules.outcome: record its use so it can be reviewed

add_heuristics.condition: a capability has not been used for a long time
add_heuristics.action: review whether it should stay registered

add_heuristics.condition: a capability's declared access exceeds what it uses
add_heuristics.action: narrow it

add_decision_rules.name: Keep a single source of truth
add_decision_rules.condition: the same entity appears in several records
add_decision_rules.outcome: resolve them to one canonical record

add_decision_rules.name: Match deterministically
add_decision_rules.outcome: use fixed, documented matching rules so the same inputs give the same result

add_decision_rules.name: Resolve conflicts by stated policy
add_decision_rules.condition: merged records disagree on a value
add_decision_rules.outcome: choose the surviving value by a documented survivorship rule

add_decision_rules.name: Keep it auditable
add_decision_rules.outcome: record the sources and the rule applied

add_heuristics.condition: a match is uncertain
add_heuristics.action: queue it for review rather than merging

add_heuristics.condition: new records arrive continuously
add_heuristics.action: process them incrementally

add_decision_rules.name: Define root and level semantics
add_decision_rules.outcome: state what the root and each level represent

add_decision_rules.name: Establish parent-child relationships
add_decision_rules.outcome: connect it to a defined parent

add_decision_rules.name: Validate each expansion
add_decision_rules.outcome: validate the new children before continuing to expand

add_decision_rules.name: Keep expansions consistent
add_decision_rules.outcome: make it consistent with the existing levels and semantics

add_heuristics.condition: an expansion repeats existing content
add_heuristics.action: drop it

add_heuristics.condition: a level's meaning drifts
add_heuristics.action: revise the definition before further expansion

add_decision_rules.name: Treat containers as ephemeral
add_decision_rules.condition: a container is built or run
add_decision_rules.outcome: ensure it can be destroyed and recreated from its definition without data loss

add_decision_rules.name: Make builds reproducible
add_decision_rules.outcome: build it from a versioned definition so the same input produces the same image

add_decision_rules.name: Automate the lifecycle
add_decision_rules.condition: a container moves from build to teardown
add_decision_rules.outcome: automate each stage including teardown

add_heuristics.condition: state is stored inside a container
add_heuristics.action: move it to external storage

add_heuristics.condition: an image is built from an unpinned base
add_heuristics.action: pin the base version

add_decision_rules.name: Cover all test levels
add_decision_rules.outcome: include tests at each applicable level (unit, integration, system)

add_decision_rules.name: Automate validation
add_decision_rules.outcome: run the automated tests on every change

add_decision_rules.name: Report coverage gaps
add_decision_rules.outcome: report the areas not covered

add_heuristics.condition: a test is flaky
add_heuristics.action: fix or quarantine it

add_heuristics.condition: a bug is found without a test
add_heuristics.action: add a test that would have caught it

add_decision_rules.name: Inspect the status code
add_decision_rules.outcome: check its status code before using the body

add_decision_rules.name: Classify errors
add_decision_rules.outcome: classify it as client or server error and as retryable or not by idempotency

add_decision_rules.name: Log error context
add_decision_rules.outcome: log the request, status, and relevant headers for diagnosis

add_decision_rules.name: Retry carefully
add_decision_rules.outcome: retry only idempotent requests with bounded, backed-off attempts

add_decision_rules.name: Standardize error responses
add_decision_rules.outcome: use a consistent format following the relevant specification

add_heuristics.condition: a server error persists
add_heuristics.action: degrade gracefully instead of retrying indefinitely

add_heuristics.condition: a client error recurs
add_heuristics.action: fix the request instead of retrying

add_decision_rules.name: Grant least privilege
add_decision_rules.condition: access is given to a registry or provider
add_decision_rules.outcome: grant minimal access and time-limit it where possible

add_decision_rules.name: Rotate credentials
add_decision_rules.outcome: rotate it on a schedule and record the rotation

add_decision_rules.name: Audit access
add_decision_rules.outcome: keep an audit record of who accessed what

add_decision_rules.name: Verify trust anchors
add_decision_rules.outcome: verify its trust anchors before trusting its content

add_heuristics.condition: a credential is long-lived
add_heuristics.action: replace it with a short-lived one

add_heuristics.condition: provider-specific code spreads
add_heuristics.action: hide it behind a common abstraction
